course.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
course.overview: Comprehensive 3rd-Year University course covering Abstract Data Types (ADTs), Asymptotic Complexity Analysis (Big-O, Omega, Theta), Sorting and Searching, Linear Structures (Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues), Hierarchical Structures (Binary Trees, BST, AVL Trees, Heaps), Graph Theory & Network Algorithms, Advanced Divide-and-Conquer Sorting, and Hash Table Engineering.
